definitions.explanation: Spirited energy or liveliness, especially as expressed outwardly through voice, manner, or attitude. Often used to describe the energetic atmosphere at markets, festivals, or workplaces.

examples.japanese: {威勢|いせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{掛|か}け{声|ごえ}→掛け声：10571_kakegoe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
⟦{魚屋|さかなや}→魚屋：14642_sakanaya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店主|てんしゅ}→店主：12451_tenshu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{威勢|いせい}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}び{込|こ}んでいる→呼び込む：06087_yobikomu⟧。
examples.english: The fish shop owner is energetically calling out to customers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{威勢|いせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よかった→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦だんだん→だんだん：00832_dandan⟧⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なくなってきた。
examples.english: At first he was full of energy, but gradually he lost his spirit.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly appears in the phrase {威勢|いせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (spirited, energetic) or the adverbial form {威勢|いせい}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧. Associated with the lively atmosphere of traditional Japanese markets and festivals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {威勢|いせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: spirited, lively, energetic
- {威勢|いせい}⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧: vigorously, energetically
- {威勢|いせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧: spirited voice/shout
- {威勢|いせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{掛|か}け{声|ごえ}→掛け声：10571_kakegoe⟧: spirited call/chant
